Name: Configurable Visual Enemy Variety
Author: LemonsOnFire
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is a replacement content.json file for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32218](CP) Visual Enemy Variety[/url] The new file just adds configuration options to disable each enemy type individually. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Once you have installed the original mod. Download this file and place it in that mod's folder and overwrite the original content.json file. 
[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]After installing and starting the game, it will create a config file. You can edit the file directly or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] in game to enable/disable specific enemy types.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]By default all monster visuals are enabled.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]

[size=4][b][u]ATTENTION [/u][/b][/size][size=3]This will not work via a mod manager it needs to be downloaded manually and then placed in the original mods folder.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]You need to have the original mod installed first and it's dependencies.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53119216]TeaLovingLad[/url] [/color]thanks for creating the original mod and if you want to incorporate these changes into the original mod you can use my file. and I will happily take this mod down.
